Target Release & Collection Quota

Final Target Quota Formula: Initial Quota (1st-Day Active Dues + 1–90d Matured Dues) − 1-Mo. Repo Deduction
• Collections to Hit Target: Cash Collections + 2.5% On-Time Rebates (Penalties excluded).
• Repos: Only 1 month's amortization of same-month repo'd units is deducted from the target.
CI Commission / Incentives (Uncapped — Paid on Actual Cash Collected):
• Final Target Quota Hit + Maximum Release = Actual Cash Collected × 0.50%
• Final Target Quota Hit + Minimum Release = Actual Cash Collected × 0.35%
• Target Quota Not Hit OR Minimum Release Not Hit = No Incentives
If a branch has 2 Credit Investigators, the earned commission is divided equally (÷ 2).
